name: Poul Halberg Powertrio
description:
Poul Halberg (guitar & vokal), Jette Schandorf (bas) og Jesper Thomsen (trommer) er navne, vi sædvanligvis forbinder med danske popsucceser som Halberg Larsen, News, Ray-Dee-Ohh, Lis Sørensen, Rasmus Sebbach, X-Factor bandet osv.

Imidlertid har de tre erfarne og kreative musikere en trio, hvor de hylder nogle af deres egne inspirationskilder fra en af rockens allermest kreative og turbulente perioder; slutningen af 60’erne!

Powertrioen giver deres eget bud på nogle af deres helt personlige favoritter fra perioden - uden et sekund at dynge musikkens tidløshed til med nostalgi!

Det engelske udtryk for at spille musik er “to play”, der jo også betyder “at lege”. Og det er lige præcis, hvad de tre musikere gør med et på alle måder helt unikt sammenspil opbygget gennem 40 års erfaring på de danske scener.

Lyt til deres seneste singler "Early In The Morning", "Up On The Roof" og "Mean Lover" fra deres kommende album, der udgives i forår 2025, nedenfor.

Er man til skarpskårne rock riffs, indfølt blues guitar og et repertoire, der både udfordrer og vækker minder, bør man opleve denne trio.

Og husk luftguitaren!

description:
WOLF ALICE – EUROPEAN TOUR 2025
SUPPORT: FLORENCE ROAD

BILLETSALGET STARTER: 23. MAJ KL. 10
BILLETPRISER FRA: 365,- PLUS GEBYR
BILLETSALG VIA: ALLTHINGSLIVE.DK / BILLETLUGEN.DK

Kvartetten fra Nordlondon har med deres prisvindende og anmelderroste mix af grunge, 90’er indierock, elektroniske elementer og store ballader pustet friskt liv i den uddøende Britrock i over et årti, da de i 2013 dukkede op på den internationale musikscene med debutalbummet My Love Is Cool. 

Wolf Alice, bestående af forsanger Ellie Rowsell, guitarist Joff Odie, trommeslager Joel Amey og bassist Theo Ellis, har lige siden surfet på en fremadstormende bølge af succes, og kan i dag skrive tre EP’er og tre anmelderroste album på repertoiret.

Deres fjerde album, The Clearing, udkommer 22. august, og sætter tonen for hvordan Wolf Alice står sonisk i 2025. Albummet består af en samling sange fulde af selvtillid, ambitioner, følelser og nye ideer. Et progressivt skift fra et band, hvis musikalske udforskning af kærlighed, tab og menneskelige relationer har sat lyd på en hel generations ’coming of age’. 

Det er ifølge bandet selv et klassisk pop/rock album, der nikker mod 1970’erne, men samtidig er solidt rodfæstet i nutiden. Hvis Fleetwood Mac skrev et album i Nordlondon i dag, ville det sandsynligvis ramme tæt på den ubesværede store lyd, der kan forventes fra Wolf Alice på den nye plade.

En ny begyndelse for bandet, der er blevet kaldt ”the best band of the decade” af DIY Magazine, og som har modtaget den prestigefyldte Mercury Price for årets album i 2018 for albummet Visions of a Life. Bandets seneste album Blue Weekend formåede ligeledes at gå nummer 1 i hjemlandet, og sikrede dem en Brit Award for Best Group. 

Takket været deres brede spektrum og vilde energi på scenen, har bandet også bevist, at de kan fylde venues i hele Europa - også herhjemme, hvor de gav en komplet udsolgt koncert i Store VEGA i 2022.

I 2025 er Wolf Alice igen klar til at indtage verdens musikscener med udgivelsen af de nye album The Clearing - og danske fans kan glæde sig til gensyn med de britiske ulve, når de giver deres hidtil største koncert i Danmark i K.B. Hallen til november.

name: Queer Wellness 🛁🫧 November
description:
DANSK
Velkommen til Queer Wellness efterår 2025 💙 Vi byder på badekar, saunagus, afslapning og backgammon i Sjællandsgade Badet for alle queer voksne hen over vinteren og lidt til.

Lejlighedsvist har vi cute pop-ups: Førhen har vi haft croquis, massage, Queer Cut, (Un)told og cute DJs på programmet. Vi annoncerer i den pågældende begivenhed, hvis der sker noget særligt 🛁 💿

PRAKTISK
🫧 Køkultur og først-til-mølle: Der er cirka plads til 50 personer. Dørene lukker, når der er fyldt.  
🫧 Donationsbaseret entré med sliding scale. Donér, hvad du kan, og hvad du tænker giver mening; alle beløb er helt okay.  
🫧 Sjællandsgade Badet er ikke niveaufrit.  
🫧 Husk håndklæde. Du bestemmer selv, hvor på- eller afklædt du vil være.  

HUSREGLER  
🫧 Queer Wellness er et rum med nøgenhed. Husk: Pronominer og køn kan ikke aflæses fra en krop. Antag ikke andres pronominer eller køn.  
🫧 Vi lader mobilen blive i tasken. Ingen fotos eller videoer er tilladt.  
🫧 Vi siger nej til racisme, transfobi, bifobi, femmefobi, homofobi, sexisme, queerfobi osv.  
🫧 Queer Wellness er et alkohol- og rusmiddelfrit rum.  

Lad os sammen skabe et tryggere rum ved at overholde husreglerne. Hvis du oplever, at husreglerne brydes, eller du på nogen måde føler dig utilpas, så tøv ikke med at komme til os, der arrangerer aftenen. Vi er typisk at finde i køkkenet i stuen og ved indgangen.

OM FLINT
Queer Wellness er drevet af frivillige fra det queerfeministiske initiativ Flint KBH. Vi er nonprofit og har tilhørsforhold i Kvindehuset på Gothersgade 37.
______________________
ENGLISH
Welcome to Queer Wellness 💙 We offer bathtubs, sauna, relaxation, and backgammon, in Sjællandsgade Badet, for all queer adults during the winter.

Occasionally, we host cute pop-ups: In the past, we’ve had croquis, massage, Queer Cut, (Un)customs, and cute DJs on the programme. We'll announce in the respective event if something special is happening 🛁 💿

PRACTICAL
🫧 Queue culture and first-come, first-served: There is space for approximately 50 people. Doors close when full.  
🫧 Donation-based entrance with a sliding scale. Donate what you can and what you think makes sense. Any amount is fine.  
🫧 Sjællandsgade Badet is not step-free.  
🫧 Remember to bring a towel. You decide how dressed or undressed you want to be.  

HOUSE RULES
🫧 Queer Wellness is a space with nudity. Remember: Pronouns and gender cannot be determined from a body. Do not assume the pronouns or gender of others.  
🫧 We leave our phones in our bags. No photos or videos are allowed.  
🫧 We say no to racism, transphobia, biphobia, femmephobia, homophobia, sexism, queerphobia, etc.  
🫧 Queer Wellness is an alcohol- and drug-free space.  

Let's create a safer space together by following the house rules. If you experience that any of the house rules are being broken or you feel uncomfortable in any way, don't hesitate to come to us, the organisers of the evening. We are typically to be found in the kitchen on the first floor or at the entrance.

ABOUT FLINT
Queer Wellness is run by volunteers from the queer feminist initiative Flint KBH. We are nonprofit and are located in Kvindehuset at Gothersgade 37.

name: Fotomarked med Copenhagen Photo Festival
description:
Fotomarked med Copenhagen Photo Festival.

Gå på opdagelse i fotobøger, -kunst og -kuriositeter, og køb værker med hjem. Vi fylder salen med boder med alt fra ‘fundne fotografier’ til kunst- og dokumentarfotografi af etablerede og spirende fotograftalenter såvel som fotobøger. Mød fotografer og fotobogaktører i boderne til en snak om værkerne og find ny kunst og bøger til vægge og reoler derhjemme.

Markedet er et samarbejde mellem Folkehuset Absalon og Copenhagen Photo Festival.

VIL DU SÆLGE?
Er du dokumentar- eller kunstfotograf, samler du på ‘fundne fotografier’ eller udgiver og formidler du salg af fotobøger? Så er dette marked noget for dig. Du kan du tilmelde dig her senest 8. oktober. Du kan også læse mere om hvordan du tilmelder dig, ved at gå til siden her

Vi opfordrer til, at man udvælger emner fra ‘bagkataloget’, som fortjener et nyt liv, og at bøger såvel fotokunst ligger i en prisklasse, hvor de fleste kan være med – gerne under 1.000 kr. og max 5.000 kr.

Vi glæder os til at se jer!

———————————————————————-

En bod koster 400 kr. for et bord som måler 220x85cm. Der hører stole med til boden.

Opsætning er mulig fra kl. 8:00 og senest ankomst kl. 9:00. Det er ikke muligt at refundere boden.

name: NATURE & CULTURE: Int. Poetry Film Fest  at the Calgary Public Library
description:
NATURE & CULTURE: International Poetry Film Festival 2025
 – November 5, Calgary

The Nature & Culture International Poetry Film Festival arrives in 2025 with a transcontinental program linking Copenhagen, Denmark, and Calgary, Canada. Presented by Red Door and the Poetic Phonotheque in partnership with Husets Biograf and the Calgary Public Library, the festival continues its exploration of the intersections between poetic language, cinema, and ecological and cultural narratives.

The 2025 edition unfolds across two cities, weaving a poetic thread between continents. On October 11, Husets Biograf in Copenhagen will host the European program, followed by the Canadian edition on November 5 at the Calgary Public Library. In both cities, audiences will experience an international selection of 32 films from 18 countries, including documentaries, poetry films, animations, experimental works, and short narratives, a program accompanied by live performances.

This year’s festival presents four curated “microfestivals,” each an hour-long journey into a distinct constellation of themes:
•	EARTHWORKS & ECOLOGIES: Cinematic meditations on land, water, climate, and more-than-human worlds, reflecting on resilience, fragility, and our shared responsibility to the living earth.
•	MIGRATION, MEMORY & MYTH: Poetic journeys through displacement and belonging, exploring archives, languages, diaspora, and ancestral stories.
•	CITY / CIRCUIT / SKIN: Works traversing urban landscapes, digital frictions, and hybrid ecologies, where bodies, infrastructures, and technologies intersect.
•	DREAMING FORMS: Experimental and surreal approaches to rhythm, voice, and image, opening prophetic, playful, and dreamlike reimaginings of the world.
In addition to film screenings, the program will include live poetry readings, filmmaker talks, and critical conversations, offering audiences a space for dialogue on pressing issues of environment, culture, identity, and imagination. Selected works will also join the Poetic Phonotheque’s international collection of poetry films, continuing the festival’s role as both artistic platform and archival project.

Further program details will be announced in the coming weeks.
For more information, visit: www.poeticphonotheque.com

name: Bliv klogere på manosfærens udvikling i Danmark
description:
Foredrag om manosfærens udvikling i Danmark med Maia Kahlke Lorentzen
Kom og få et overblik over den såkaldte manosfære i Danmark.
 Manosfæren er en løs samling af grupperinger med navne som incels, scorekunstnere, internettrolde, manderetsaktivister og andre, som dog deler nogle fælles holdninger til køn, bl.a.  kønsessentialisme og antifeminisme.

Maia Kahlke Lorentzen researcher og formidler internetkultur, online hadfællesskaber og digital chikane i organisationen Cybernauterne. Hun har siden 2007 fulgt udviklingen i det, der ofte kaldes manosfæren. 

I de mellemliggende år har fremvæksten af sociale medier og deres netværkseffekt betydet, at den danske manosfære har en langt større tilstedeværelse både online og offline. Manosfæren i Danmark har fået flere aktører og digitale fora samt flere formelle organiseringer, der sætter politiske og kulturelle dagsordener.
 
Tematikkerne omkring maskulinitet i krise og fædres rettigheder under angreb fra feminister og den danske stat er dog stadig en central del af den danske manosfære. Dagsordenerne er også rejst ind i den danske mainstream-politiske debat, f.eks. i diskussioner om tabermænd, feminiserede folkeskoler og #MeToo.
I 2025 deler manosfæren i Danmark både netværk, dagsordener og indimellem direkte samarbejder med konservative kristne, konspirationsteoretikere, højreradikale og “anti-woke” kulturkrigere.

Kom og hør Maia Kahlke Lorentzen gennemgå tidslinjen i manosfærens udvikling. 

Arrangementet er gratis og kræver ingen tilmelding.
Det foregår på Nørrebro Bibliotek.

name: The Commitments
description:
The Commitments (1991) is a loud, funny, and heartfelt celebration of music, ambition, and community. Jimmy Rabbitte, a sharp young dreamer from North Dublin, decides to bring soul music to his neighborhood — and gathers an unlikely group of musicians to make it happen.

Based on Roddy Doyle’s acclaimed novel, the film brims with energy, humor, and unforgettable performances. From Motown-inspired hits to raw Irish spirit, The Commitments shows how music can unite people across backgrounds and give voice to a generation.

A joyful and timeless story about finding your sound — and your people.

name: Nova Concerts: The Timba Legacy
description:
The concert is the final chapter of a journey that began two concerts ago. With Akokán, Nova explored the ancestral heartbeat of Afro-Cuban music — its rhythms, rituals, and stories born from the African diaspora. With Resonancia, the focus shifted to how those rhythms evolved into melodies and travelled across cultures. Now, LEGACY celebrates the living sound of that evolution — music that originated in the streets of Havana, transcended borders, and continues to move audiences worldwide.

At the heart of this special night is the Cuban-Danish band Grupo Danson , the legendary orchestra that in the early 2000s shaped a new chapter of Cuban music in Europe. Founded by trombonist Carlos Pérez , bassist Yasser Pino , and trombonist Mia Engsager , and brought to life by the extraordinary Alexander Abreu , Danson fused tradition and innovation, proving the global reach and emotional depth of Cuban music. Original Danson pianist Rune Thorsteinsson will join the concert, adding his unmistakable touch.

Audiences can expect more than a performance — LEGACY is an invitation to experience the joy, depth, and cultural power of Cuban music, even if they’ve never heard it before. It’s a night where stories are told without words, where rhythms bring people together, and where a room becomes a celebration.

This concert is a reunion. A celebration. A Havana night in Copenhagen. A great finale for Nova Concerts Series 2025, and everyone’s invited!

name: 6 years of Konkylie
description:
For the past six years, Konkylie has made its mark as one of Copenhagen’s most vital cultural forces. With last year’s opening of Bodega Konkylie and this year’s launch of Konkylie Studio, they established themselves as a brand that takes art and culture seriously. With features in Vogue Taiwan and appearances in everything from museums to magazines, it’s evident that Konkylie is on a rise as a vital cultural contributor.

Now, Konkylie invites you to celebrate the release of their compilation “6 Years of Konkylie (Songs from the Film)”, featuring music by Kayak, Polite, Peter Pain, Demersal, Yvonnes, and First Flush. Come celebrate at Xenon — one of Copenhagen’s most beautiful and underrated venues, and be part of the celebration of six years of music, creativity, and culture.

The evening will unfold as a playful blend of flowers, aesthetics, visuals, live shows, DJ sets, and an extraordinary screening of the 30-minute film “6 Years of Konkylie”. The film has only previously been shown at its premiere at Empire in Nørrebro and as part of the official Spot Festival program.

name: Game On: Catan tournament

name: Lost2Reality: Sofus Forsberg (live) + P(h)ony Cat
description:
For the second installment in the series of electronic Wednesday concerts, Lost2Reality presents a rare opportunity to experience Sofus Forsberg in an experimental live set on his modular system. We’re also very pleased to once again be joined by P(h)ony Cat, bringing along a melting pot of melancholic melodies and quirky beats.

Sofus Forsberg:

An experienced producer who lives for atmospheric, industrial sound within the deeply hypnotic techno genre. This evening, however, is something special, as Sofus breaks away from techno’s sharp 4/4 rhythms with an experimental live set.

Sofus is known for his virtuosic live performances on modular synthesizers, where, after six years in Berlin, he became an organic part of the thriving and inspiring techno scene. His music is created for both dance and reflection, with the intention of offering a deep and transformative experience—uplifting yet intense—resembling a modern shamanistic journey.

In recent years, highlights have included performances at renowned festivals such as Modem, Ozora, and Boom, as well as in clubs across Europe—and at the Boiler Room Machines event.

P(h)onycat:

Behind the DJ project P(h)onycat is Matilde Møller – an experienced connoisseur in the Aarhus electronic scene. Since the early 00s, Matilde has been nerding out and collecting electronic music.

P(h)onycat’s sets are melodic, genre-anarchistic, and playful. Free from the 'modern' DJ dogmas of genre, bpm, and 4/4 mixing. It’s clear that Matilde’s musical upbringing is rooted in the 90s, where she fell in love with jazz, IDM, and trip-hop.

Expect skewed beats and melancholic melodies – a musical melting pot of electronica, IDM, drum'funk, soul, hip hop, avant-garde pop, and all that JAZZ.

name: Je T'aime [FR] + Support: Pharmacist [SE]
description:
Det bliver en aften med post-punk og new wave når franske Je T'aime besøger Stengade og Danmark for første gang d. 5 november! Post-punk bandet Pharmacist fra Sverige varmer op.

Je T'aime:
JE T'AIME: for these few letters, some live, some go mad, but above all, many die.

Live until you go mad, live until you die - that's the credo of the cold-wave trio whose spirited spleen sprang from the muggy basements of Parisian nightlife in 2018. While the classic post-punk and new wave influences are obviously there, the driving rain that falls on these three anti-heroes is tinged with the flashing colors of neon lights and their artificial heat. JE T'AIME stirs up your guts as much as your behinds, and blows the codes with a jubilant, touching snarl.

After a self-titled debut album released in 2019 on Manic Depression and Icy Cold Records, the band signed the diptych PASSIVE/AGGRESSIVE in 2022, choosing Valentine's Day and All Souls' Day to release both parts. In the few years of its existence, JE T'AIME has rocked audiences at Belgium's W-Fest, Poland's Castle Party Festival, England's Infest Festival, Portugal's Extramuralhas and Germany's Wave Gotik Treffen... If Europe has to learn a few French words, it might as well be “JE T'AIME”.

In 2025, JE T'AIME is seven years old. Their new album, Useless Boy, is an expressionist cry, a sad party where the melancholic thrill is always hidden behind illusory comforts. More than ever, it's a flight into the future, a rejection of the dreary conventions of the real world. JE T'AIME locks itself away in its own intimate universe to avoid confronting dull, tasteless normality. Sorrows are sublimated by the all-consuming energy of a trio for whom maturing rhymes with dying, skilfully
juggling nostalgia and modernity.

+ Support: Pharmacist
Swedish post-punk outfit Pharmacist was formed in Gothenburg in 2017 and consists of the siblings Moa Dannejford (vocals, guitar) and Julian Dannejford (drums), Gustaf Grönlund (bass) and Olle Oscarsson (guitar). In January 2018, the band presented themselves to the world with the EP Renaissance, turning heads with noisy, melodic, and energetic pop songs. They were praised on national television by legendary music journalist Per Sinding-Larsen as one of the most promising young indie bands in Gothenburg, and their EP was released on limited vinyl by Malmö's Rundgång Rekords.

The band eventually grew disillusioned by the limitations of a perceived but largely misguided association with the “Gothenburg sound” and partly relocated to Malmö, where they found a more genre-fluid and open-minded artistic environment. Their sound became more experimental and bass-driven, giving space for Moa’s complex, often metaphorical lyrics as well as her charismatic and uncompromising Patti Smith-esque stage persona. Known as an intense, energetic and emotional live act, the band draws on a wide set of influences, of which some of the more obvious include groups such as The Fall, The Birthday Party and Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds. Yet, Pharmacist's sound remains profoundly their own, carried by the charisma and musical characteristics of each individual member. New material is currently in the works.

name: Rett Smith (US) - Support: Daisychain (US) - BETA
description:
140 kr. i forsalg / 160 kr. i døren
Døre kl. 19 / show kl. 20
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄

Rett Smith er en sanger, sangskriver og guitarist fra Texas. Han begyndte sin karriere som professionel alpin skiløber, men efter flere skader vendte han sig mod musikken i sine tidlige 20'ere. Hans musikalske rejse begyndte med EP’en 'Tularosa' i 2015. Siden da har han udgivet flere soloalbum, herunder 'Giving Up on Quitting' (2020), 'What the Walls Cannot See' (2021), 'Americana Drugs' (2022) og 'A Nightly Consequence' (2023), og det har etableret ham som en markant stemme inden for Americana og rock.

Smiths musik er kendetegnet ved en mørk, cinematisk lyd, og en vokal der sammenlignes med Nick Cave. Hans dybt personlige fortællestil trækker på hans egne erfaringer og følelser, og han er i øvrigt også været medlem af rock’n’blues-projektet SAENTS.

I efteråret 2024 udgav han albummet 'A Weighted Remorse', der blev rost af kritikere og fans. Smith fortsætter med at turnere og optræder regelmæssigt i Europa og USA, hvor han deler sin musik og sine historier med et voksende publikum, og nu kan man opleve ham på spillestedet BETA i København.

___

Daisychain er en psykedelisk bluesrock-trio fra Chicago, dannet i 2017. Deres lyd trækker på elementer fra 70’ernes rock, garage og moderne psych, med rå energi og melodisk tyngde. Bandet består af Nickole Regala (bas og vokal), Frankie Sripada (leadguitar) og Sophia Williams (rytmeguitar og vokal). Debutalbummet 'All In A Name' udkom i juni 2025 og er produceret af den legendariske Sylvia Massy, kendt for sit arbejde med blandt andre Tool og Red Hot Chili Peppers.

Med fængende riffs, vokalharmonier og et skarpt udtryk markerer Daisychain sig som et af Chicagos mest lovende nye rockbands.

name: Slow Crush (B) - BETA
description:
150 kr. i forsalg / 170 kr. i døren
Døre kl. 19 / show kl. 20
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄

Slow Crush er et shoegaze-band med base i Belgien, der blev dannet i 2017. Gruppen har hurtigt markeret sig internationalt med deres drømmende, støjende og atmosfæriske lyd, der trækker tydelige tråde til 90’ernes alternative rockscene. Bandets musik kombinerer slørede guitarlag og tunge basgange med sfæriske vokaler som melankolsk bidrager til det drømmeagtige udtryk.

Debutalbummet 'Aurora' (2018) modtog stor ros i undergrundskredse og skaffede dem opvarmningsjobs for bl.a. Soft Kill og Torche. Opfølgeren 'Hush' (2021) udvidede paletten med mere følelsesmæssig dybde og en mørkere, mere introspektiv tone – uden at give afkald på bandets karakteristiske lydmur.

Slow Crush er kendt for deres intense koncerter, hvor de lydmæssige lag nærmest omslutter publikum i en tåge af feedback, distortion og æteriske harmonier. Tekstuniverset kredser ofte om sorg, isolation og længsel, men uden at tippe over i det sentimentale.

Med en lyd, der både er nostalgisk og moderne, har Slow Crush cementeret deres plads som et af de mest spændende navne i den nye bølge af shoegaze.

name: SEASON 3 - THE GRAND CULMINATION: EXTENDED 26-HOUR SEASON FINALE EPISODE @ Den Anden Side/Pumpehuset
description:
SEASON 3 - THE GRAND CULMINATION: EXTENDED 26-HOUR SEASON FINALE EPISODE @ Den Anden Side & Pumpehuset (DAS’ Birthday Party)

Saturday, November 8-10 │ Soft Selection │ Techno, House

________

On its third anniversary, the iconic club, Den Anden Side, transforms into a sprawling, multi-dimensional narrative, inviting on a 26-hour celebration of the club’s enduring spirit.
__

Plot:
-- Setting: Den Anden Side on a chilly evening, November 8th.--

The final episode airs at 22:00 where the "Confession Bar" concept provides an intimate opening inviting guests to "confess" their past three years of club memories over welcome drinks, while warming up for the midnight live act on the club’s main floor. 

As the final notes fade out and the crowd cheers, the main floor plunges into a darker soundscape and a lineup of pure and pounding techno. Rolling kicks and hypnotizing synth lines fill the room, and headlining is a true legend, highly requested by Den Anden Side’s members accompanied by 2 amazing local acts.

When approaching the smaller dancefloor, the beats intensify - A vortex of energy, with pulsating trance melodies and hard bounce rhythms fueling a euphoric frenzy. Two b2b’s of some of the clubs many DAE highlights in the past year.

-- Setting: Pumpehuset on a sunny morning, November 9th. --

As dawn breaks, the dancers from DAS go on the traditional pilgrimage towards Pumpehuset. They meet well-rested friends on the way and all come together at the iconic Smoker’s Floor for the CRINGE morning party. Think cheesy pop anthems, forgotten hits, and a deliberate embrace of all things delightfully "cringe”, complete with breakfast and mimosas. This is a fun interlude, a playful nod to the absurdity and joy of long nights and mornings after the club.

At noon, Sort Sal ignites with the vibrant, uplifting sounds and energy of house and hardgroove. Flown in from abroad, a dancefloor angel who always delights the floor enters the booth, alongside some of the club’s dearest local residents and friends.

Meanwhile, the torch has been passed at Smoker’s Floor, where local trance-loving DJs will keep the fire going until way past sunset.

-- Setting: Pumpehuset past midnight on, November 10th. --

As the marathon draws to a close, a sense of collective accomplishment and renewed energy fills the air.

This season finale isn't just a party; it's a living, breathing testament to three years of shared experiences, culminating in a celebration that promises many more seasons to come.

The final act involves a collective, heartfelt cheer, leaving us all with a lingering sense of connection and heartfelt anticipation for what Season 4 and our future together hold.

___

Whether you’ve got main character energy or are more of a background dancer, you are all important to make this final Season 3 episode unforgettable.

So save the date
and join us!

▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Den sjælfulde singer/songwriter Calum Scott indtager ikoniske K.B. Hallen den 7. november med sange fra sit nye album “Avenoir”, som udkommer d. 12. september.“ Avenoir” markerer det nyeste bidrag til i et imponerende katalog, der også tæller det guld-certificerede debutalbum “Only Human” fra 2018, som indeholder 5x platin-hittet “You Are The Reason” og den ikoniske 3x platin coverversion af Robyns “Dancing On My Own”, som blev nomineret til en BRIT Award i kategorien Bedste Britiske Single. 

Da Calum Scott i 2015 gik til audition til talentshowet ”Britain’s Got Talent”, havde han måske ikke forestillet sig, at det skulle blive adgangsbilletten til en glorværdig karriere. 
Men med sit smukke neddæmpede cover af Robyns ikoniske ”Dancing on My Own” imponerede han ikke alene dommerpanelet. Præstationen førte til en kontrakt med et af verdens største labels Capitol (ABBA, Coldplay, Katy Perry), som i 2016 udsendte covernummeret, der solgte 600.000 eksemplarer via topplaceringer på hitlisterne i bl.a. England, Australien, Sverige, Irland og Danmark. Nummeret blev desuden brugt i den populære tv-serie ”The Vampire Diaries”.
I 2018 fulgte debutalbummet ”Only Human”, hvis miks af store smukke ballader med følelserne uden på tøjet og uptempo-popsnacks placerede Calum Scott som et af de hotteste nye navne blandt moderne singer/songwritere som Ed Sheeran, Dean Lewis og Lewis Capaldi. Debuten bragede da også ind i top 5 på albumhitlisterne i England og Australien og modtog flere guldplader.
Efter at have turneret i bl.a. hjemlandet og USA helligede Scott sig igen sangskrivningen. Resultatet af det arbejde udkom i 2022 form af hans andet studiealbum ”Bridges”, der konsoliderer hans position som en af tidens fremmeste musikere til at forene klassiske singer/songwriter-dyder med moderne popproduktion. Og med pt. mere end 23 mio. månedlige Spotify-lyttere er han fortsat en af Englands tunge drenge i mainstreampoppen.
Calum Scott har netop udgivet den flotte single “God Knows”, og fans kan nu glæde sig til endnu mere ny musik med det nye album, “Avenoir”. Der er derfor garanti for både nye numre og klassikere fra bagkataloget, når den engelske hitsmed indtager K.B. Hallen den 7. november.

name: Soundvenue LIVE: Yorgos Lanthimos' 'Bugonia'
description:
Blod, hjernemasse og en shaver indstillet på nul millimeter.

Det er ikke så lidt, Yorgos Lanthimos udsætter Emma Stone for i deres nyeste power-mov(i)e ’Bugonia’, som vi nu i samarbejde med CUPRA kan invitere til landets første visning af ved Soundvenues forpremiere mandag den 3. november.

I makkerparrets fjerde spillefilm-samarbejde efter ’The Favourite’, ’Poor Things’ og ’Kinds of Kindness’ spiller Emma Stone en succesfuld tech-CEO, Michelle, der en dag kidnappes ude foran sit hjem af en flintrende konspirationsteoretiker, Teddy, og dennes tilbagestående fætter.

Den på alle måder beskidte Teddy spilles af en mere nylig Lanthimos-favorit, altid forrygende Jesse Plemons, og han og Stone giver hinanden kamp til stregen i en både vild, sjov og foruroligende opvisning i førsteklassesskuespil.

Teddy er overbevist om, at Michelle er et rumvæsen, og uanset hvad hun siger for at overbevise om det modsatte, får han vendt og drejet hendes ord, så det ikke lyder helt så skørt, som man skulle tro.

»Som en syret eventyrversion af et mærkelig Reddit-forum« og »en af de mest intense farcer over red pill-kultur i nyere tid«, kaldte Soundvenues Mathilde Johanne Kristiansen ’Bugonia’ efter verdenspremieren på Venedig-festivalen i slutningen af august.

Nu rammer den græske mesters nye knaldperle af en film Danmark, og det starter altså ved Soundvenues forpremiere i Empire Bio.

name: With Hasan in Gaza (Kamal Aljafari, 2025) I Præsenteret af Tusind sole og Empire Bio
description:
“I went to Gaza twenty-four years ago searching for a friend, without an address.” 

Den 4. november kl. 19.00 præsenterer Tusind sole og Empire Bio Kamal Aljafaris ’With Hasan in Gaza’ (2025). Filmen er grundlæggende en road movie, der bevæger sig fra det nordlige Gaza til det sydlige i en søgen efter en ven, hvis skæbne er ukendt. Den er en filmisk refleksion over minder og tab, og den fanger et Gaza fra fortiden og liv, der måske aldrig vil blive fundet igen.  

Al overskud fra denne visning doneres til Thousand Madleens.

Læs mere på: https://tusindsole.dk/with-hasan-in-gaza
Billetpris: 50 kr.

--------------
OM FILMEN
--------------
'With Hasan in Gaza' havde verdenspremiere i hovedkonkurrencen på dette års Locarno filmfestival, men den er lige så gammel. som den er ny: Den består af optagelser fra tre nyligt genopdagede MiniDV-videobånd, som instruktør Kamal Aljafari optog i Gaza i 2001. Han var rejst dertil for at finde en ven, han havde siddet i fængsel med i 1989, og havde den lokale guide Hasan Elboubou ved sin side på rejsen.

Filmen er grundlæggende en road movie, der bevæger sig fra det nordlige Gaza til det sydlige i en søgen efter en ven, hvis skæbne er ukendt. Med kameraet i hånden passerer Aljafari og Elboubou legende børn ved havet, ruiner, mennesker i samtaler, mens Israels angreb fylder nætterne. 

Aljafaris behandling af dette hjemmevideo-materiale er minimal. Han har ikke tilføjet en essayistisk fortællerstemme, der reflekterer over alt det, der er gået tabt siden 2001. Han har heller ikke tilføjet nyt billedmateriale. Han har blot indføjet enkelte tekststykker, som indrammer filmen, samt et diskret soundtrack, der blander nykomponeret musik med populære sange fra regionen. Ellers lader Aljafari råmaterialet være filmen og stoler på, at det kan reflektere for sig selv. Dokumenter fra dengang, set med øjne fra i dag.  

'With Hasan in Gaza' er en filmisk refleksion over minder og tab, og den fanger et Gaza fra fortiden og liv, der måske aldrig vil blive fundet igen. Kamal Aljafari anvender filmmediet til at undersøge, hvordan billedernes figurative materialitet kan blive en abstraktion og et spøgelse, og kobler denne undersøgelse til et område, der er lige så virkeligt og konkret, som det er abstrakt og fantasmagorisk: Palæstina. 

Selv har Kamal Aljfari udtalt om filmen: “En hyldest til Gaza og dets befolkning, til alt det, der blev udslettet, og som kom tilbage til mig i dette presserende øjeblik af palæstinensisk eksistens eller ikke-eksistens. Det er en film om katastrofen og den poesi, der modstår.”

-----------------

description:

name: Testing Ground : Sidsel Nelund : Mapping of Fear in the Art World – Who is Afraid of Fear? (Part 1)
description:
Join us for a sharing session with art researcher, non-fiction writer and cyclical agent Sidsel Nelund who will bring together art professionals to reflect on the subject of fear. This session is the first of three in the open research investigation Who's Afraid of Fear?

In a critical era of polycrisis, fear acts as both a physical and mental force that transforms the art profession. Throughout the fall, we will approach fear from different perspectives and in multiple ways.

In this session, we will collectively create a visual map of fear within the artistic and cultural industries. What fears affect art professionals and practitioners? Where do these fears come from? How do they shape art practices, practitioners, and the collective endeavors they are part of?

The session is open to everyone working in the art industry—regardless of role—who would like to contribute to uncovering fear in the art world from their unique perspective.

INFO
Mapping of Fear in the Art World – Who is Afraid of Fear? (Part 1)
Monday 3 November at 3:15-6:00PM

2400 Copenhagen NV

A ticket is 25 DKK and can be bought through Billetto here: https://billetto.dk/e/testing-ground-sidsel-nelund-mapping-of-fear-in-the-art-world-who-s-afraid-of-fear-part-1-billetter-1675838?utm_source=organiser&utm_medium=share&utm_campaign=copy_link&utm_content=1

Please note that the event will be in English.

~

PROGRAM
15:15: Arrival and settling in with tea and coffee
15:30: Welcome and introduction to Who’s Afraid of Fear?
15:45: Collective mapping in groups
16:30:  Break
16:45: Collective mapping in plenum
17:30: Drinks
18:00: Closing

OUTPUT
As part of the session, we have invited artist and clairvoyant Anu Ramdas and artist and writer Sidsel Ana Gajardo to respond to the session with visual and written notes, which serve as collective documentation of the open research and its findings. All statements are anonymized.

~

ABOUT WHO'S AFRAID OF FEAR?
Who is Afraid of Fear? grows from observing fear as a major force in the artistic professions – and often in unspoken ways. This underlying fear drive hinders art production and Who is Afraid of Fear? sets outto find ways to localize and transform this fear and release what fear holds back. Taking inspiration from Black African American embodiment traditions and South American hospicing modernity practices, Sidsel Nelund will, over a series of sharing sessions, weave together a hybrid method that is at once theoretical, communal, and emotional. Rooted in the cyclical creativity approach she has developed over the past decade, these sessions will explore fear with curiosity, compassion and connection.

Nelund hopes to inspire a practice of courageous togetherness. Since fear both binds people and disperses them, what might happen if we gather to normalize fear and find ways to move beyond it?

The investigation is conducted as part of a book project that Sidsel Nelund explores through the Testing Ground, an AHC public programme aimed at providing artistic researchers with the opportunity to test ideas and methods in practice.

OM SERIEN
------------------------------------

East by Southeast - Nye film fra Central- og Østeuropa
Nye film fra central- og østeuropa

Godt 35 år efter kommunismens kollaps udviser filmproduktionen i Central- og Østeuropa stadig fællestræk i emnevalg og stil. Det skyldes selvfølgelig, at landene deler en fælles (nyere) historie og en række af de samme økonomiske og sociale udfordringer.

description:

name: Copenhagen Short Film Festival 2025 - More Than Your Job
description:
With the last block we screen for the 2025 Copenhagen Short Film Festival edition we want to prepare you to face the week ahead, and remind you that you're "More Than Your Job".

From passion to paycheque, these four short films explore the complex relationship between people and work. Some find meaning and identity in what they do; others simply do what they must to get by. Each film casts the workplace in a different light: warm when it stirs nostalgia, cold when it feels alienating, dark when it exposes shady sides, and vivid when work fades into the background and people take centre stage. In the end, the workplace becomes what it should be, a backdrop for what truly matters: people, and how they navigate life’s challenges. Because we are more than our jobs.

In this programme you'll find the films:

- Just the Usual, Dir. Nanna Tange
- Fading Colors, Dir. Aleksander Emé
- Diminished, Dir. Thomas Sander Klan
- Limp Along, Dir. Michael Kunov

description:

name: Copenhagen Short Film Festival 2025 - Between Order and Chaos
description:
Between order and chaos lies the fragile space of being human. These short films explore the cracks in the systems we build. Cracks of care, love, and identity, where rules meant to protect us often fail. Here, longing collides with control, and resilience takes shape in unexpected ways. Darkly funny, tender, and deeply moving, these films reveal what rises to the surface when structures break: our endless need to connect, to be seen, and to hold on to one another as the world slips through our fingers.

In the programme you'll find the films:

- Instructional Video No. 360 — Dir. Jakob Lebech Krog
- No Place for a Kid — Dir. Dawn Florinda Wall
- What About Us? — Dir. Aviaja Skotte
- Lovesick — Dir. Alexander Saul

name: Copenhagen Short Film Festival 2025 - Young Danish Talent
description:
In the programme 'Young Danish Talent', we present a selection of short films made by emerging Danish filmmakers.

Through six personal stories, these young filmmakers offer insights into their world while exploring the creative potential of the film medium. The films in this program explore modern relationships and self-realisation through the eyes of a younger generation. What unites them is a willingness and curiosity to create stories with a distinct personal voice.

name: Copenhagen Short Film Festival 2025 - BIG MOOD
description:
We are not going to sugarcoat this - BIG MOOD is a bit of a melancholy block. Get your smile filter on, and join us in going through rejection, bad friends, tough family situations, trying to impress with mixed results - and just simply being sad sad sad. But perhaps it is the cracks where the light can shine through - so come and find those grains of positivity and humour served to you with these fresh off the press, highly cinematic shorts.
